objective_for_doctor: A 50-year-old F patient presents to the clinic. Chief complaint: cough.

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?
I’ve had nasal congestion or a clear runny nose and a cough. I also have pain around the top of my head, both cheeks, and both temples, with intensity 6 out of 10.

Doctor: Thanks—when did this start, and do you have fever (≥38°C) or thick/yellow-green nasal discharge?  
Doctor: Any facial pain worse when you bend forward, and is the cough mostly dry or producing phlegm?
I don’t know. I haven’t mentioned whether the facial pain is worse when I bend forward, and I don’t know if the cough is mostly dry or producing phlegm.

Doctor: Understood—do you have fever/chills, and is your nasal discharge clear/watery or thick/discolored? Also, does the facial pain increase when you lean forward or when you press on your cheeks/forehead?  
Doctor: If you’re not sure, tell me whether the cough has been getting better or worse over the last 3–5 days, and if you have any shortness of breath or wheezing.
I don’t know. My cough hasn’t been getting better or worse that I can say over the last 3–5 days, and I don’t know about shortness of breath or wheezing.

Doctor: I’ll check your vitals and do a focused exam—do you currently have fever/chills, and can you blow your nose: is the discharge clear or discolored?  
Doctor: Also, are you able to point to whether the face pain is mainly over the cheeks/forehead, and is it tender when I press?
I don’t know about fever/chills or whether I can blow my nose—whether the discharge is clear or discolored.

Doctor: I’m going to examine you now—please tell me: do you have any tooth pain or worsening pressure when you bend forward, and do you smoke or have asthma/COPD?  
Doctor: Also, how long has the cough and nasal symptoms been going on total (days vs weeks), and do you have colored sputum (yellow/green) or is it dry?  
Doctor: REQUEST TEST: CBC and CRP; also REQUEST TEST: Sinus_imaging (CT_sinuses or plain sinus series per availability) if you have significant facial tenderness/pressure.
I don’t know how long the cough and nasal symptoms have been going on total, and I don’t know if my sputum is yellow/green or if the cough is dry.

Doctor: I’ll treat this as possible acute rhinosinusitis given your facial pressure/pain plus cough—right now, do you have a recent cold (start within the last 7–10 days) and any loss of smell or worsening symptoms after an initial improvement?  
Doctor: Also, on exam, do you have facial tenderness to tapping/pressing over the cheeks/forehead, or any nasal pus/discharge, and what are your current temperature and oxygen saturation?

I don’t know about whether I’ve had a recent cold within the last 7–10 days, or about loss of smell or whether symptoms got worse after an initial improvement. I also don’t know about my temperature or oxygen saturation.

Doctor: I’ll perform a quick bedside check—can you tell me your current temperature (if you’ve measured it) and whether you can breathe comfortably without shortness of breath, and on a 0–10 scale is the facial pain worst over the cheeks, between the eyes, or temples?  
Doctor: Also, is your cough mainly from post-nasal drip (worse when lying down) or chest-sounding wheeze/crackles—and any tooth pain in the upper teeth?

I don’t know. I’m not sure about my temperature or oxygen saturation, whether I have shortness of breath, whether the pain is worst over the cheeks versus between the eyes versus temples, whether the cough is from post-nasal drip or from wheezing/crackles, or whether I have tooth pain in the upper teeth.

Doctor: I’m going to request a couple of quick checks because you’re unsure: REQUEST TEST: Vitals (temperature, HR, BP, SpO2) and REQUEST TEST: Lung_exam/Chest_Auscultation.  
Doctor: In the meantime, can you tell me whether your symptoms have lasted **>10 days**, or if there was an **initial improvement then worsening** (double-sickening)?
I don’t know.

Doctor: Since you’re unsure about duration/fever and the pattern, I need a few key answers quickly—how many total days since symptoms started, and do you have fever or severe facial pain (yes/no)? Also, can you tell me if your cough is worse when lying down (post-nasal drip) or if you feel chest congestion/wheeze (yes/no)?

I don’t know. I haven’t been able to say whether it’s worse when lying down or whether I feel chest congestion/wheeze, and I don’t know about fever or severe facial pain.  

I do have nasal congestion or a clear runny nose and a cough, and the pain intensity is 6/10 with the pain locations including the top of the head, both cheeks (R and L), and both temples (R and L).

Also, have you had **fever (≥38°C)** or bad tooth pain?

Doctor: REQUEST TEST: Vitals (temperature, HR, BP, SpO2) and REQUEST TEST: Focused sinus exam (tenderness/housekeeping + nasal discharge quality) with REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray only if lung exam is abnormal or shortness of breath is present.
